comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
People skipped this one, eh?

Agamemnon, a new battleship that will come out in Chapter 3 of Seven Wonders update "Pharos". Requires Large 3-decked Hull and can be built in London for 49 days.

Levels needed to sail: already stated above
Vertical sails: 260
Horizontal sails: 210
Turn speed: 14
Wave resistance: 13
Armour: 50
Durability: 840
Sailors required: 85
Sailor cabin: 180
Cannon chambers: 110
Hold: 460
Capacity volume hold: 750
Studding sails: 3
Special equipment: 2
Extra Armouring: 3
Broadside: 5
Bow turret: 1
Stern turret: 1

Optional Skills:
Explosive Shell
Bullet-proof Armouring
Armour Piercing Bullet
Special Sea Mine
Command Post
Repair Support

Apparently, shares the same vertical/horizontal sails upper limit as Whydah (Whydah), rower featured in Chapter 2 of Seven Wonders.

Credit to Beomi for the information!
